name: Contrarian trade MA
summary: This EA implements a contrarian mean-reversion strategy using moving averages. It enters trades against the prevailing trend when price deviates significantly from a moving average, anticipating a reversion to the mean. The strategy opens positions on pullbacks and manages exits via take-profit and stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用移动平均线实现逆势均值回归策略。当价格显著偏离移动平均线时，它逆势开仓，预期价格将回归均值。策略在回撤时建仓，并通过止盈止损水平管理出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是逆势交易，即当价格偏离移动平均线达到一定幅度时，反向开仓预期价格回归均值。入场条件是价格相对于均线的偏离度超过预设阈值，可能在均线上方过度延伸时做空，在均线下方过度偏离时做多。出场条件依赖固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈设于均线附近或回归目标位，止损设于偏离继续扩大的位置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未见动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应手数计算。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比控制，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的机制，整体风控较为简单。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is contrarian trading, entering positions against the prevailing move when price deviates significantly from a moving average, anticipating a mean reversion. Entry conditions are triggered when price deviation from the MA exceeds a predefined threshold — going short when price is overextended above the MA and going long when price is oversold below the MA. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels in points, with TP set near the mean reversion target and SL placed where the deviation would continue to widen. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic lot calculation or ATR-based adaptive sizing. Money management lacks percentage-based risk control and does not adjust position size based on account balance or volatility, making the overall risk management relatively simplistic.

pros: 逆势交易逻辑清晰，在震荡市中有较好表现
使用均线偏离度作为入场依据，概念直观易懂
设定了明确的止盈止损，有基本的风控框架
pros_en: Clear contrarian logic that performs well in ranging markets
Uses MA deviation as entry signal, concept is intuitive and easy to understand
Has defined TP/SL providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 固定手数无动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险调整暴露
逆势策略在强趋势市场中会持续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下不利
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management cannot adjust exposure to account risk
Contrarian strategy suffers continuous losses in strong trending markets, lacks trend filter
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle
No spread filter makes it vulnerable in high-spread conditions
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势开仓
引入基于账户余额百分比或ATR的动态仓位管理
添加新K线检查和点差过滤以提升执行质量
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trends
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR
Add new bar check and spread filter to improve execution quality

risk_points: 固定手数无动态风控，大资金时风险暴露不成比例
逆势策略在单边行情中可能连续止损
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic risk control leads to disproportionate exposure with larger accounts
Contrarian approach can result in consecutive stop-losses during strong directional moves
Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
